sub_indicators.label: Satellite data in agriculture
sub_indicators.subject: data.satellite
sub_indicators.text: Agricultural use of satellite data: satellite data in agriculture
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Space Strategy asks that space-derived products be used for decision-making; the AU Digital Agriculture Strategy asks for remote sensing in monitoring and forecasting.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no farming service or institution uses satellite or remote-sensing data.
A ministry, agency or research institute used satellite or remote-sensing data in a farming study or pilot, or is preparing a service that will.
A government crop-monitoring, drought or locust early-warning, or land-use service using satellite data is in service, for part of the country or for one purpose.
Such a service publishes bulletins, maps or forecasts on a schedule.
A number of farmers, extension workers or districts receiving advice, alerts or insurance based on the service's satellite data is on record.
